currentWork.title: FINAL.46 HGV timeout bounds tested and merged; Vercel daily deployment quota blocks API release
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.46 source code was tested and merged; GitHub Pages serves FINAL.46, but the live Vercel route API still serves FINAL.45 because the daily free deployment quota was exceeded (HTTP 402, api-deployments-free-per-day, retryAfter 86400). Do not treat FINAL.46 as production-complete.
releaseScope: Upstream ORS and Overpass fetch now time out across response headers AND response JSON body, instead of only the initial response headers.
Optional via-IC highway searches are limited by a 14.5-second server request budget and return the already validated HGV base route when additional highway probes exceed the budget.
A report distinguishes a time-budget-limited optional search from a baseline HGV route acquisition error.
driving-hgv, exact vehicle restrictions, max two via-IC candidates, FINAL.36 final detour limits and 30/min call guard are preserved.
Root cause of the user's exact iPhone timeout has NOT been independently reproduced; a device retest after Vercel deployment remains essential.

decision: A failed Vercel deployment cannot count as a completed FINAL.46 route fix.
Do not weaken vehicle safety, long-detour caps or ORS call limits to work around slow responses.
Do not upgrade/bill the user's Vercel account without explicit approval; wait for the provider quota window to reset.
On next execution, verify latest main and exact deployed SHA before making a single Vercel production deployment. Avoid repeated deploy loops.
Do not ask user to retest until both the frontend and backend report FINAL.46.
nextActions: After Vercel reports the free daily deployment quota available again, deploy the latest verified main to the existing production Vercel project using its linked Git source.
Verify Vercel deployment READY, correct current-main SHA, and public /version.json == 2026.10.08-FINAL.46.

If Vercel quota remains blocked, do not repeatedly trigger new builds.
